Theorem
[Bakry--Concordet--Ledoux rigidity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0358 ↗ def:chow-ii-ch16-euclidean-log-sobolev ↗ cor:chow-ii-ch16-entropy-rigidity 1. ch16:16.35\group Entropy Rigidity

On a complete manifold with $\operatorname {Rc}\ge 0$, the Euclidean logarithmic Sobolev inequality holds for every normalized positive density if and only if $(M,g)$ is isometric to $\mathbb R^n$.
